# Psalm 62 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** For Jeduthun, the music director. A psalm of David.

**2** I wait quietly before God, for my victory comes from Him.

**3** He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress where I will never be shaken.

**4** So many enemies against one man — all of them trying to kill me. To them I'm just a broken-down wall or a tottering fence.

**5** They plan to topple me from my high position. They delight in telling lies. They bless with their mouths but curse in their hearts. Pause and reflect.

**6** Let all that I am wait quietly before God, for my hope is in Him.

**7** He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress where I will not be shaken.

**8** My victory and honor come from God alone. He is my refuge, a rock where no enemy can reach me.

**9** O my people, trust in Him at all times. Pour out your heart to Him, for God is our refuge. Pause and reflect.

**10** Common people are as worthless as a puff of wind, and the powerful are not what they appear to be. If you weigh them on the scales, together they are lighter than a breath of air.

**11** Don't make your living by extortion or put your hope in stealing. And if your wealth increases, don't make it the center of your life.

**12** God has spoken plainly, and I have heard it many times: Power, O God, belongs to You;

---
## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

- **62:10**: On the cosmic scales, all of humanity together weighs less than a breath. This isn't misanthropy — it's perspective. Only God has genuine weight (glory/kavod).

— PNEUMA
